name: Michigan 4-H Exploration Days (at Michigan State University)
org: Michigan State University Extension, Michigan 4-H Youth Development
what_you_do: Stay on the MSU campus for three days with about 1,000 other youth. You pick two or three of more than 100 sessions taught by MSU faculty, 4-H volunteers and staff. You live in a dorm and eat in the dining hall, with free time for skating, a dance and more.
who_can_apply: Youth ages 12 to 19 from across Michigan (the MSU Spartan Youth listing shows grades 6 to 12). Some sessions have their own age limits, based on your age on January 1. You go with your county 4-H group and its chaperones.
pay_detail: The 2027 cost is $250. It covers meals from Wednesday lunch to Friday lunch, two nights in a shared dorm room, sessions and a t-shirt. A $50 pre-payment is due when you register. Your county MSU Extension office may have scholarship money.
deadline_text: The 2027 event is June 23 to 25, 2027. Registration opens in March. In 2026 it opened March 12 and ran through April, and the full fee was due June 1.
how_to_apply: Talk to the 4-H staff at your county MSU Extension office, since youth go as a county group. Then register online when registration opens in March and pay the $50 pre-payment. Popular sessions fill first. Questions: 4h.expodays@msu.edu.
notes: Read in a browser on 2026-10-19 on the program's own 4-H Exploration Days pages at MSU Extension. The page posts the 2027 dates and the 2027 price. The 2027 registration dates are not posted yet, so the March to April window is the 2026 pattern. It is a statewide event held in East Lansing, so it may also be listed as a Michigan-wide card. Not a job.
